description: Part-addressed intervention chunk (flag waddle.v0.parts): three joint-position steps that address a single declared part of a Composite space by name — two 'left' waypoints then one 'right' — instead of a CompositeAction naming every part. Pins that Action.part is per step (one chunk may address different parts in different steps), that a part-scoped step's width is the ADDRESSED PART's width (7, against robot_description_bimanual_composite.json's 14-wide composite), and that the parts a step does not address carry no command at all ('move this part, hold the rest', docs/FSM.md §4). No gripper sidechannel rides these steps: the canonical bimanual declaration folds each gripper into its part's joint vector (GripperSpec.actionDim = -1), so the gripper IS the seventh value.
